digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration seam / RP-01 Pydantic AI migration
propositions: Rebar's bespoke structured-output orchestration must be replaced with Pydantic AI seams while preserving exact historical behavior around deterministic repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, provider fallback, usage accounting, telemetry, and failure taxonomy

A behavior-crossing offline probe using Pydantic AI 1.107.2 real Agent/output/retry/limits/hooks seams must establish baseline observable behavior for all ticket-derived and test-derived scenarios without live model calls

Seven maintainer decisions govern the replacement: one operation-wide request budget; complete failed-response inclusion only on proven deterministic fit; aggregate successful-retry usage into one operation row; narrow exhaustion translation to exact Rebar-owned error in cause chain; and trace-not-usage candidate observability

All nine acceptance criteria for Phase-4 research (behavioral matrix, test/ticket mapping, current/observed behavior, decision dispositions, offline probe execution, artifact persistence, comment recordation, and operator-attested read-back) were satisfied by 2026-08-16 with no production code changes
